title: Tawasal Association Provides 600 Assistive Devices to 2,000 Users
summary: The Saudi-based Tawasal Association for Assistive Technology for People with Disabilities has provided 600 assistive devices to 2,000 beneficiaries, expanding access to essential tools for individuals with disabilities.
body:
The Saudi-based Tawasal Association for Assistive Technology for People with Disabilities has provided 600 assistive devices to 2,000 beneficiaries, expanding access to essential tools for individuals with disabilities.
